content: claude -p (--print) runs non-interactive single-turn. --output-format json returns structured JSON with cost/session_id. --max-turns N caps agentic turns. --max-budget-usd for cost guard. NEVER build command via shell string — use Command::new('claude').args(['-p', &task]) to avoid shell injection. Children inherit full env including ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. --bare skips CLAUDE.md/hooks/MCP for faster startup.
